metadata.question: Were the agricultural fields between the Kakhovka and North Crimean Canals in Ukraine browner on June 18, 2023 than on May 17, 2023?

data.raw_code: The user is asking if agricultural fields between two canals in Ukraine were "browner" on June 18, 2023 compared to May 17, 2023. 1. Search strategy: - Location: Need to define a polygon between Kakhovka and North Crimean Canals in Ukraine - Data: Use Sentinel-2 for vegetation analysis (good for NDVI) - Time periods: May 17, 2023 and June 18, 2023 (± a few days for cloud-free images) 2. Masking strategy: - Need to mask clouds to get clean vegetation data - Use NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) as proxy for "browness" - lower NDVI = browner 3. Logic: - Calculate mean NDVI for each date period - Compare: if June NDVI < May NDVI, then fields were browner (Answer A) - Handle edge cases: no data, no valid pixels, calculation failures The area between these canals is in southern Ukraine (Kherson region). I'll create a polygon that covers the agricultural area between these two canal systems. For vegetation analysis, I'll use NDVI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red) where: - Red: B4 in Sentinel-2 - NIR: B8 in Sentinel-2 Lower NDVI values indicate less vegetation/browner conditions. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define ROI - agricultural area between Kakhovka and North Crimean Canals in Ukraine const roi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [33.5, 46.8], [34.2, 46.8], [34.2, 46.3], [33.5, 46.3], [33.5, 46.8] ]); // Date ranges (±3 days for cloud-free images) const mayDate = ee.Date('2023-05-17'); const juneDate = ee.Date('2023-06-18'); const dateRange = 3; // days // Function to get cloud-masked Sentinel-2 image function getCloudFreeImage(targetDate) { const startDate = targetDate.advance(-dateRange, 'day'); const endDate = targetDate.advance(dateRange, 'day'); const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); return collection.median() .updateMask(collection.count().gt(0)) .clip(roi); } // Function to calculate NDVI function addNDVI(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } // Get images for both periods const mayImage = getCloudFreeImage(mayDate); const juneImage = getCloudFreeImage(juneDate); // Check if collections have data const mayCount = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(mayDate.advance(-dateRange, 'day'), mayDate.advance(dateRange, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) .size(); const juneCount = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(juneDate.advance(-dateRange, 'day'), juneDate.advance(dateRange, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) .size(); const maySize = mayCount.getInfo(); const juneSize = juneCount.getInfo(); console.log(`May images: ${maySize}, June images: ${juneSize}`); if (maySize === 0 || juneSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Process images and calculate NDVI const mayNDVI = addNDVI(mayImage).select('NDVI'); const juneNDVI = addNDVI(juneImage).select('NDVI'); // Calculate mean NDVI and pixel counts const mayStats = mayNDVI.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: roi, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const juneStats = juneNDVI.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: roi, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mayResult = mayStats.getInfo(); const juneResult = juneStats.getInfo(); console.log(`May NDVI: ${mayResult.NDVI ? mayResult.NDVI.toFixed(3) : 'NaN'}, Pixels: ${mayResult.NDVI_count}`); console.log(`June NDVI: ${juneResult.NDVI ? juneResult.NDVI.toFixed(3) : 'NaN'}, Pixels: ${juneResult.NDVI_count}`); // Check for valid pixels if (mayResult.NDVI_count === 0 || juneResult.NDVI_count === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failures if (mayResult.NDVI === null || juneResult.NDVI === null || isNaN(mayResult.NDVI) || isNaN(juneResult.NDVI)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare NDVI values (lower NDVI = browner) if (juneResult.NDVI < mayResult.NDVI) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
